create_YOLOXModeSwitchHook: create a YOLOXModeSwitchHook instance with custom num_last_epochs and skip_type_keys parameters
use_YOLOXModeSwitchHook_before_train_epo: use the before_train_epoch method to disable mosaic and mixup augmentation during training
register_YOLOXModeSwitchHook: register the YOLOXModeSwitchHook module in the HOOKS registry for YOLOX training
configure_skip_type_keys: configure skip_type_keys to control which data augmentation pipelines get disabled during training
switch_to_L1_loss: switch the bbox_head to use L1 loss automatically in the last epochs of training
